DDR - Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Dataset

The DDR (Diabetic Retinopathy Detection) dataset is a large-scale collection of retinal fundus images designed for training and evaluating algorithms in diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading and lesion-level segmentation.
